patterns.note: Content is presented in a highly minimalist, centered layout with generous vertical whitespace, creating a sense of spaciousness and focus on individual elements.
A single, highly distinctive and rounded display typeface is used exclusively for the main brand logo, contrasting sharply with a simple, understated sans-serif for all other textual content.
The site employs a stark monochromatic palette of deep black text and elements against a very subtle off-white background, with no additional accent colors.
The oversized hero logo dramatically scales down and repositions from the center of the screen to the top-left corner, becoming a persistent, smaller header element as the user scrolls down.
Team members are introduced with unique, stylized, cutout-style illustrations, each accompanied by their name and role, arranged in a clean grid.

technique_notes: A large, centered hero element (the brand logo) dynamically scales down and transitions to a fixed position in the top-left corner of the viewport as the user scrolls, effectively transforming into a sticky header.
Content sections below the initial hero appear to slide up into view with a subtle reveal effect as the user scrolls down the page, maintaining a smooth flow.
A persistent footer containing navigation links remains fixed at the bottom of the viewport once it has been scrolled into view, providing continuous access to key actions.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, rounded display font for the hero (~8x body) with small, understated sans-serif body text and labels.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy, especially in the hero and between main content blocks, creating a sense of spaciousness and deliberate hierarchy.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is the dynamic, transforming hero logo that dramatically scales and repositions to become a sticky header upon scroll. This, combined with the unique, stylized illustrations for team members, gives the site a strong, memorable personality that feels more like an art piece than a generic agency portfolio.
